branch_policy: Work directly on dev per feedback_no_prs_commit_to_dev memory. Commit per-milestone locally; push origin dev only after M8 quality gates pass. No feature branch, no PR.
architecture: Frontend-only refactor. Invert per-artefact-frame filter from allowlist (explicit-route-each-kind) to denylist (drop-noisy-kinds, forward-everything-else) via new useArtefactReportEvent hook. Existing central useSimSnapshotPush + proactiveEventCheck.ts mapper unchanged.

deviations: LED Planck drop set includes led-planck.measurement (not in original plan) — caught by existing test that expected it dropped because it comes from the React Results surface, not the iframe. Same pattern applied to KineBot for graph-change + quiz-attempt.
LED Planck did NOT need a pause/reset drop (artefact doesn't emit those kinds) — empty drop set apart from the measurement entry.
